fact: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade's National MSME Policy 2024-2029 proposes a start-up matching fund, a simplified tax regime for start-ups and an MSME Act, noting new firms pay the same corporate tax as established ones.
title: Eswatini National Policy for Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise (MSME) 2024-2029
publisher: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade
